decisions.referenceFirst: Inspected read-only local kit project instructions, switch and fabric meshes. Kit projects contained no suitable sheet STL; downloaded and parsed CC BY4.0 White Cat actual STL before final geometry. Reconstructed rather than repaired its defective source seams.
decisions.sheet: Measured0–1.60mm main sheet -> default1.60mm, supported1.60–2.40mm. Frame separately thickened by proposed.25mm total vertical sliding gap.
decisions.carrier: Measured.21–.22mm low webs and surrounding subdivided carrier -> new two-row carrier with28 accessible bed-aligned.4–.6mm thick runners.
decisions.interfaces: Source4.50×1.700012mm socket recorded, NOT repurposed as an unrelated bolt interface.4.50mm cover window nominal span only; all new dynamic gaps explicitly redesigned.
decisions.mechanism: Three10×18mm sliders with right-facing4mm deep notches offset-3/0/+3mm. Comb has three2–3mm teeth,4mm nominal lateral stroke. Slots give.20–.40mm per-side running gap; sheet+.25mm guide depth. .50mm nominal clearance to notch back, at least.10mm at full tolerance limit.
decisions.retention: Separate cover captures gate edges with1.50mm overlap and bolt spine with≥1mm overlap at nominal stroke limits. Floor and guide stops bound motion. Frame/floor/cover REQUIRE adhesive; moving parts stay unglued. No security, friction-force, physical-print or bond-strength claim.
decisions.personalization: PNG/JPEG/SVG threshold/grayscale20×20 heightfield Boolean engraving and exact convex STL Boolean engraving in exposed apron at(10,-pitch-28).13mm-diameter keep-in zone;≥1mm backing, isolated from guide pockets.
decisions.difference: New multi-input notch-and-comb interlock with27 encoded combinations. Not a relabelled optical window, single shuttle, quarter-turn cipher or vernier scale. Existing local studio UI/import/export scaffolding reused, moving geometry and collision tests newly authored.
decisions.limits: Tilt/yaw play and forces not dynamically simulated. Supported straight guide poses sampled and stops/capture checked; physical friction, adhesive strength and printing untested.
